call.svg.rationale: The handset is recognizable at 12px and 16px; its two receiver-root curves remain visible at all reviewed widths. The four handset tips stay crisp in the shared outline and solid silhouette. Compared on both backgrounds with adjacent action icons in the earlier independent Storybook review.

decisions.reason: These are the four purposeful handset tips, not structural concave joins. The receiver-root welds are separate tangent arcs; rounded tips would weaken the phone silhouette.
